findings.description: Collision with the hardening PR's ADR-SAG-0029 (a-10 @ sprint/a-10-phase-end-hardening, Active when it merges). The plan does not reuse the number 0029, but two plan statements contradict 0029 content without naming it. (1) r-1 D10.10 and the ADR-0020 r-1 amendment (docs/architecture.md:380) delete `ResolvedApiKey::new` and make `try_new` the only constructor. ADR-0029(a) keeps an unchecked `new` under `cfg(test)` or `sc-agent-types/test-util`. (2) r-1 converts the two `#[allow(clippy::disallowed_methods)]` sites to `#[expect]` (https.rs, transport.rs). ADR-0029(a) says those sites carry `#[allow]`. r-3 deletes both sites later.
findings.remediation: Add to the ADR-0020 r-1 and r-3 amendment text an explicit line that it supersedes the named ADR-SAG-0029(a) sentences. State that the test-util `new` is removed in r-1 and that tests use `try_new`. In r-3 D-section 'Closes findings', cite ADR-0029(a). Also add a note that `sc-agent-secrets` has no features, per ADR-0029(a), as the architecture.md:406 'Correction' paragraph already says.

findings.description: Plan is silent on ADR-0029(b): `sc_jev_py._testing.run_check_scripted`, `sc-jev-py` feature `test-util`, and string-shorthand normalisation inside `register_scripted_backends`. r-3b's pytest `test_partial_failure_raises_with_response` has no stated scripted seam for Python. Plan.md 'Test seams' says `test-util` is enabled only by dev-dependencies, but the `_testing` seam is enabled by a maturin feature flag. `sc-jev-py` is also edited by r-2 and r-3b. r-2 line 308 cites `docs/sc-jev-py/architecture.md` 'line 25', which a-10 rewrites.
findings.remediation: State in r-3b D6 that Python scripted injection uses `_testing.run_check_scripted` per ADR-0029(b). Record the maturin-feature exception in plan.md 'Test seams'. Re-anchor r-2's sc-jev-py doc edit by section rather than by line. Add a merge note for the index rows: a-10 rewrites the 0020 and 0022 index rows (and the 0022 body Amended-by line), and the plan also edits the 0022 row. The resolution is `Amends ADR-SAG-0009; amended by ADR-SAG-0029; ADR-SAG-0024 (Proposed, r-2)`.
